MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 11
   C. 5
   D. 24

2. Solve for x: x + 4 = 8. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 4
   C. 8
   D. 5

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 156

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 15
   C. 13
   D. 7

5. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 2
   D. 24

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 24

7. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 56
   C. 1
   D. 57

8. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.025

9. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

10. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

11. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 90

12. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

13. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 11
   C. 121
   D. 22

14. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 12

15. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 14

16. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 3
   C. 41
   D. 13

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
